news.headline: Katsis was likely elevated as a backup returner in case Marvin Mims (foot) is unable to suit up for Sunday's contest. Ka
news.detail: Katsis was likely elevated as a backup returner in case Marvin Mims (foot) is unable to suit up for Sunday's contest. Katsis, an undrafted free agent out of Northern Arizona, is set to suit up for his first NFL game but may be inactive if Mims is all set to play.
